mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ntf_info ( internal_user_id, installation_id, device_token, device_id, brd_cd, platform_type, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{internalUserId}, #{installationId}, #{deviceToken}, #{deviceId}, #{brdCd}, #{platformType}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} ) ON CONFLICT (internal_user_id, installation_id) DO UPDATE SET device_token = EXCLUDED.device_token, device_id = EXCLUDED.device_id, brd_cd = EXCLUDED.brd_cd, platform_type = EXCLUDED.platform_type, updated_at = EXCLUDED.updated_at
mapper.update: UPDATE ntf_info SET device_token = #{deviceToken}, device_id = #{deviceId}, brdCd = #{brdCd}, platform_type = #{platformType}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE internal_user_id = #{internalUserId} AND installation_id = #{installationId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM ntf_info WHERE internal_user_id = #{internalUserId} AND installation_id = #{installationId}
